title: Drowned Cache
description: A waterlogged chest sits half-buried in the sand, its iron bands green with verdigris. The bodies of its former owners lie sprawled nearby, picked clean by crabs. Whatever killed them left the cargo untouched.

choices.label: Pry it open
choices.description: The lock is rusted through and gives way easily.

choices.label: Search the bodies nearby
choices.description: Their belt pouches hold vials of concentrated brine venom.

choices.label: Salvage the wood
choices.description: The chest itself is built from solid timber, still usable.

choices.label: Leave the dead in peace
choices.description: Disturbing the drowned invites bad luck.
